lines.text: This is The Language Page: interactive English practice for multilingual learners, teachers, and families.
Pick a grade, and start practicing in minutes.
Explore the four language domains: listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
Each has its own studio, with activities built around the language of school.
Or step into games and worlds, where every mission practices real language.
Every activity moves through four steps: warm up, learn, try, and reflect.
Listen again, or slower. Open word help in English and Spanish.
Choose an answer, say how sure you are, and check it.
You get specific feedback right away, with a next step.
Learn with help, or try it independently.
Want ACCESS-style practice? Open the Access Prep hub, with practice tests and an assessment simulator.
lines.tts: Want ACCESS style practice? Open the Access Prep hub, with practice tests and an assessment simulator.

lines.text: Your Growth Map shows evidence of what you can do, and what to practice next, not scores.
Teachers can start with one real activity for each domain, and students choose the help they use.
Families can practice together, with directions in English, Spanish, or both.
One place to build English skills, at your own pace.
The Language Page. Start at thelanguagepage.com.
